Style: coherent coarse pixel art intended to read like a character on an approximately 96x128 logical pixel grid; crisp stepped pixel clusters, restrained dark outline, just three shade steps per material, consistent upper-left light and a three-quarter camera. No smooth painted gradients, photographic skin, tiny hatching or noisy dithering. Keep attached clothing and prop details opaque; no broad translucent shadow. Character specification follows:

assets.subjectPrompt: NOVICE: an approachable adult man in his twenties with short dark-brown hair, ordinary healthy build, white T-shirt, blue-grey gym shorts, white socks and navy trainers. Natural warm skin, cool grey and turquoise clothing; a tiny orange zipper pull connects the sprite to Gym-Beam. No medical crosses or writing on the bag or key tag. The tag is a plain recognizable key fob, not a phone or drink.
